title: Warm Canadian Bannock Bites
description: A delicious keto bannock recipe in bite-sized form, perfect for a quick snack. Soft, warm, and full of flavor.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine almond flour, coconut flour, and granulated sweetener.
Add in melted butter and mix until a dough forms.
Gradually add in beaten egg and mix until combined.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth.
Cut into squares, about 2 1/2 inches per side.
Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush tops with beaten egg for a golden glaze.
Bake for 18-20 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
